title: Weighted Power Means on Upper Triangular Matrix Groups
summary: We study weighted power means on the Lie group $\operatorname{UT}_n$ of real upper triangular matrices with positive diagonal entries. For $t\in\mathbb R\setminus\{0\}$, the weighted power mean $P_t(\mathbf{w}; A_1,\ldots,A_m)$ is defined by \[ X=\sum_{i=1}^m w_i(X\#_tA_i), \qquad X\#_tA:=X(X^{-1}A)^t. \] Using divided differences, analytic matrix functions, and the Parlett recurrence, we prove existence, uniqueness, and real-analytic dependence of $P_t$ on the data and the weights.
